Subject: Your wrongful termination matter - Complaint No. 1984/2021

Dear Ms. Krishnan,

Thank you for meeting us on 20 February 2022 about your dispute with Aravali Industries. As we understand it, the employer withheld the last salary.

Our advice is to file a claim for unpaid wages before the labour authority. Please collect the attendance record and the salary slips and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
